title: Indian States and Union Territories: Quiz

questions.question: As of 2020, how many states does India have?
questions.rationale: Jammu and Kashmir's 2019 reorganisation into two union territories brought the count from 29 states down to 28 — the pre-2019 figure is the trap option.

questions.question: The 1956 States Reorganisation Act created states primarily on the basis of:
questions.rationale: The act redrew the map along linguistic lines, creating 14 states and 6 union territories and ending the multi-lingual provincial patchwork.

questions.question: Which was the first Indian state created on a linguistic basis?
questions.rationale: Andhra State was carved out of Madras in 1953 after Potti Sriramulu's fast — three years before the 1956 act made it the general rule.

questions.question: The smallest state of India by area is:
questions.rationale: Goa (3,702 sq km) is the smallest state. Sikkim is the least populous — a different superlative the paper swaps in.

questions.question: Which three states were created in November 2000?
questions.rationale: Chhattisgarh (1 Nov), Uttarakhand (9 Nov) and Jharkhand (15 Nov) all attained statehood that month — same year, three different dates.

questions.question: The southernmost point of India is:
questions.rationale: Indira Point on Great Nicobar island is the southernmost tip of Indian territory. Kanyakumari is only the southernmost tip of the mainland.

questions.question: Which state has its administrative capital at Dispur?
questions.rationale: Dispur, a locality of Guwahati, serves as Assam's capital — the classic 'capital that is not the famous city' question.

questions.question: In 2019, the state of Jammu and Kashmir was reorganised into:
questions.rationale: It became the UT of Jammu and Kashmir (with a legislature) and the UT of Ladakh (without one), effective 31 October 2019.

questions.question: Dadra and Nagar Haveli was merged with which territory in 2020?
questions.rationale: The merger, effective 26 January 2020, created the single UT 'Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu', reducing the UT count to eight.

questions.question: The largest state of India by area is:
questions.rationale: Rajasthan (3.42 lakh sq km) leads by area; Uttar Pradesh leads by population — two superlatives the paper perpetually exchanges.
